name: Korea Airport Service Co.,Ltd.
summary: Korea Airport Service Co.,Ltd. provides aircraft ground handling services in South Korea. It offers aircraft ground handling equipment rental and air cargo unloading services. The company also manufactures and sells drinking spring water; and provides livestock farming services. The company was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Korea Airport Service Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Korean Airlines Co.,Ltd.
